items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Ihr Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats eingelegt werden; die Monatsfrist rechnet vom Ende des Tages an, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist.
items.computation: The letter is dated 23.03.2027 but states it was posted ('Zur Post gegeben am') on 25.03.2027. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a tax letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 25.03.2027 + 4 days = 29.03.2027, which is Ostermontag (Easter Monday, a public holiday) in Bremen, so delivery shifts to the next working day, Tuesday 30.03.2027. The one-month objection period (§ 355 AO) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on the same-numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 30.03.2027 + 1 month = 30.04.2027, a Friday and a normal business day, so no further shift is needed. (Using the printed Bescheiddatum of 23.03.2027 instead as the posting day gives the same final result, 30.04.2027, confirming the date.)
